findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_v2" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Image Search (V2) Billing per call: 1 Credits." → after: "Google Images results for a query, twenty a page: for each image its URL, width and height, its thumbnail with width and height, and the page it is on. `response.next_cursor` fetches the next twenty (null after the last page). Billing per call: 1 Credits."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
